_comment: PART 4 SPIKE ARTEFACT -- PROPOSED test matrix for banking entity
preservation across a translation boundary. THIS IS A DESIGN, NOT
AN IMPLEMENTATION. No entity_guard.py exists and none is written
here. Nothing in app/ reads this file.
Two assertion kinds, and the distinction is the whole point:
string_invariant   -- the exact characters must survive the round
trip. Asserted on the text itself.
semantic_invariant -- the PARSED value must survive. Asserted on
Asserting a semantic invariant as a string is the classic way this
kind of suite becomes useless: 'five thousand rupees' and '5000
rupees' are both correct, and a string check fails the good one.
Two test boundaries, and rows declare which they need:
mt_round_trip  -- regional text -> English -> regional text.
Testable TODAY with typed input. No audio.
full_pipeline  -- audio -> ASR -> MT -> understand() -> entities.
BLOCKED: repository contains no speech audio in

severity_scale.1: a wrong value moves money or misidentifies an account. Must never ship unasserted.
severity_scale.2: a wrong value derails the conversation but is recoverable by the customer repeating themselves.
severity_scale.3: cosmetic or tone; worth knowing, not worth blocking a release.

categories.rule: MUST BE BYTE-IDENTICAL end to end. Never translated, never re-grouped, never converted to Devanagari/Kannada numerals, never expanded into words, never truncated.
categories.why: The value is echoed back as a receipt ('I've noted that', manager.py:2561) and the customer stops repeating it. A silently altered digit is never caught.

cases.note: Devanagari digits in, ASCII digits out. Tests numeral folding, not passthrough.
Spaced grouping must normalise to one run, not lose a digit.

categories.rule: The NUMERIC VALUE must be preserved exactly. The surrounding words may be translated freely.
categories.may_change: the word for rupees, word order, digits vs words
categories.why: Indian grouping (2,00,000) and the lakh/crore scale are the highest-value 10x error class in this product. '2 lakh' read as 2 is as wrong as read as 2000000.

cases.note: crore. Included because a scale error here is the largest possible.

categories.rule: MUST BE TRANSLITERATED, NEVER TRANSLATED. A name that is also a common noun must not be turned into that noun.
categories.why: Many Indian given names are ordinary words. Machine translation renders them as the word. 'Kamala' becoming 'lotus' puts the wrong name on a banking form.

cases.note: kamala is literally 'lotus'. The canonical trap case.

categories.rule: Polarity MUST be preserved. A refusal must never round-trip into a command.
categories.why: contains_negation() reads English ASCII tokens only (manager.py:281). Once the deterministic tier runs on translated text, a dropped negation executes the command the customer refused. This is the single highest-severity row in the matrix.

cases.input: I don't want to withdraw money

cases.note: 'do not cancel'. Must never execute cancel.

categories.rule: The round trip must select the SAME label from app/intent/intents.py.
categories.why: IntentDetector is a total function with no abstention (detector.py:24-29). A mistranslated request does not fail loudly -- it starts the wrong banking workflow at low confidence.

categories.rule: English banking terms embedded in regional speech must reach the English core as those same terms.
categories.may_change: the regional scaffolding around the English terms
categories.schema_field: canonical English text handed to understand() and IntentDetector
categories.why: This is how people actually speak in a branch. Every candidate's weakest case, and the one most likely to be skipped because clean single-language sentences are easier to assemble.

cases.note: term_normalizer.py only repairs ASCII Whisper mishearings; it is a no-op on mixed script.

cases.input: loan apply maadoke documents yenu beku

what_must_never_be_translated: the numeric VALUE of an amount (its wording is free)
what_may_be_translated_freely: the word for a currency and all sentence scaffolding

blocked_on.full_pipeline_rows: No speech audio exists in this repository in any language. phase3_format_check.wav is a 3.0s synthetic tone (peak 0.80, RMS 0.64, float32 16 kHz), not speech, and Whisper returns an empty transcript for it. Every full_pipeline row needs a real recorded corpus first.
blocked_on.mt_round_trip_rows: Testable today via typed input, once a translation provider is chosen. No audio required.
